It provides a graphical configuration UI, automatic updates, system tray integration, and one-click start/stop for the CLIProxyAPI service. CLIProxyAPI is a proxy server that provides OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Codex/Grok compatible API interfaces for CLI. You can access the following providers locally and with multiple CLI accounts through any OpenAI (including Responses), Gemini (including Interactions), or Claude-compatible client or SDK.
